Name: The Stardew Squad
Author: Isaldae
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Hang out with your favorite NPCs![/size][/b][/center]
With this mod, you can now invite NPCs to follow you around and do tasks with you! Water crops, cut down trees, explore the mines and more with the help of your neighbors.

[b][size=5]Update 0.12.0: Multiplayer & Splitscreen compatibility![/size][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35341/35341-1778596715-1077437092.png[/img]

It is finally there! You can now enjoy the mod while playing with your friends. I did my best to squash all the bugs I saw while testing, but some may remain, so please report them if you see any!

[b][size=5]Beta Disclaimer[/size][/b]
I decided to post this mod right now to gauge interest, but it is still very young in its development and therefore may be prone to bugs and lag. Be aware of this when downloading!
I’ll do my best to make the mod more stable in the future, but as long as it is in beta, do consider yourself warned.
I recommend to install the [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-132#post-121034]Non-Destructive NPCs mod[/url], so that if any bug occurs, NPCs won’t destroy things in your farm.

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
As of Beta v0.12.0 :
[list]
[*]Press “E” (keybind can be changed) while facing or hovering your mouse over a nearby NPC to recruit them.
[list]
[*]Do it again on an already recruited NPC to dismiss them.[/*]
[*]A dismissed NPC will return to their schedule for today[/*]
[*]You can recruit up to 3 NPCs by default, but you can increase this number in the settings.[/*]
[*]You can also recruit Pets like your cat or your dog! Due to their lack of opposable thumbs, they can’t use tools and therefore can only defend you against monsters for now.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Press “F” (keybind can be changed) while hovering your mouse over a tile (or facing the tile, if using a controller) to have your companion perform a task on it.
[list]
[*]For example, pointing at a tree will have them chopping it ; pointing at a monster will have them fight it, etc.[/*]
[*]This is also a way to prioritize an action or a monster while fighting, since the NPC will stop what they’re currently doing to perform the action![/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Press “LeftAlt + F” to toggle squad tasks on and off. You can still assign tasks manually with “F” while this is toggled off.[/*]
[*]Press “LeftAlt + E” to access the squad’s inventory (keybind can be changed). Members can pick up items on the floor and will by default put them into this inventory. You can choose to disable this behavior and have them directly put the items in your inventory instead.[/*]
[*]Recruited NPCs can:
[list]
[*]Harvest mature crops,[/*]
[*]Pick up forage and shake berry bushes,[/*]
[*]Cut down trees that the player already started cutting,[/*]
[*]Mine rocks,[/*]
[*]Water dry crops or dirt,[/*]
[*]Attack hostile monsters,[/*]
[*]Fish when you do,[/*]
[*]Milk cows and goats,[/*]
[*]Shear sheeps,[/*]
[*]Pet farm animals and pets,[/*]
[*]Sit down near you when you do,[/*]
[*]Ride with you on your horse (limited to the first squad member).[/*]
[*]More coming! Check the roadmap if you’re curious.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]All of the tasks that the NPCs can perform automatically are configurable in the settings. There are two modes:
[list]
[*]Autonomous: The NPC will seek to perform the task automatically if it’s nearby.[/*]
[*]Mimicking: The NPC will only perform the task if the player does.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Squad NPC Configuration[/size][/b]
With a modpack, you can add dialogue, idle animations, special sprites/frames and other configurations for your chosen NPCs. Check out the guide [url=https://github.com/vegacodedev/the-stardew-squad/blob/main/TheStardewSquad/NpcConfigAuthorGuide.md]here[/url]!

[b][size=5]Roadmap[/size][/b]
Right now, I will be focusing on adding the following features (in no particular order):
[list]
[*]Adding tappable buttons for mobile to bring up the recruitment/management menu, toggle automated tasks and open the Squad inventory.[/*]
[*]More controller compatibility.[/*]
[*]Having NPCs sleep with you in beds if dating/married. If they sleep with you, they’re still with you the day after.[/*]
[*]Adding an RPG-inspired expansion to the mod:
[list]
[*]An experience system for each individual NPC that will make them stronger and faster in chosen areas with every gained level,[/*]
[*]Gear and combat styles (melee with sword/dagger/hammer, ranged, magic, healing…),[/*]
[*]Unique abilities/buffs depending on who the recruited NPC is,[/*]
[*]Making animations prettier, closer to the player’s.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]SVE & Expansion mods:[/b] Compatible[/*]
[*][b]Modded NPCs:[/b] Compatible[/*]
[*][b]Modded Pets:[/b] Compatible[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer/Splitscreen:[/b] Compatible, but support is still very recent so expect some bugs. Please report them if you see any![/*]
[*][b]Mobile:[/b] Compatible with a virtual keyboard. I will add tappable buttons for mobile in a future update.[/*]
[*][b]Controllers:[/b] Not tested, but the mod’s keybinds should be modifiable to your convenience.[/*]
[/list]Feel free to test and report any compatibility issues.

[b][size=5]Supporting the mod[/size][/b]
Your enjoyment of the mod is really all I need, but if you want to support me on top of it, you can now do it on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/thaliafawnheart]Ko-fi[/url]!
